`create_model` determines `flat_snapshots` and flattens the snapshots stored in `n.model.parameters`, but never converts `sns` itself from the MultiIndex returned by `as_index`. It therefore still passes a MultiIndex to the variable and constraint builders—including the transmission-loss builders—when `"flat"` or `"auto"` under v1 semantics requires flat tuple labels; the component-data context does not change that argument.
